items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: there was a man named Mitchell Parrish who had a lot to do at Stardust, you know. But they don't say Parrish, because, go on, the other fellow is better known, you see.

ctx.x: Well, I'll get her to close the joint up, and we'll make it run until five. They throw me out at five, though. Make me close it up. I want to ask you one question. Well, ask her. Because you were talking and I was out of the room.

Who was Sidney Ayrton? Sidney Ayrton was a sax and clarinet player from Drew Holman. She was a very fine one, very good man. And he played up north somewhere. How I mentioned him, and I have mentioned him a time then, because he wrote Lazy River. You know, Carmichael has his name on lots of tunes, but for instance, when you mention Stardust, you say Carmichael Stardust. But there was a man named Mitchell Parrish who had a lot to do at Stardust, you know. But they don't say Parrish, because, go on, the other…
